_README: Copy to secrets.json (gitignored) and replace each value. JSON has no comments, so every value here is a one-line description of the key, never a real value. Used via: flutter run --dart-define-from-file=secrets.json
SUPABASE_URL: REQUIRED. Project URL, https://<ref>.supabase.co . Public by design (ships in every binary); RLS is the wall, not secrecy.
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: REQUIRED. Supabase publishable/anon key. Also public by design. NOT the service-role key, which must never enter this file or any build.
GEMINI_API_KEY: REQUIRED for prescription/lab/medicine-box scanning. Google AI Studio key. Compiled into the mobile binary today — see HANDOVER.md blocker B2. NEVER pass this to the admin web build.
GEMINI_MODEL: OPTIONAL. Overrides GeminiConfig.defaultModel (currently gemini-3.6-flash) without a code change.
GEMINI_FALLBACK_MODEL: OPTIONAL. Overrides the one-shot fallback model (currently gemini-flash-latest) used on 404/503/429/timeout.
GEMINI_THINKING_BUDGET: OPTIONAL. Integer token budget, or 'off' to omit the field entirely. Default 0 (thinking disabled) to keep reads fast.
GOOGLE_SERVER_CLIENT_ID: OPTIONAL, unused today. Google Web client ID (Supabase's audience) for Google Sign-In. Needed when blocker B1 is paid.
GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID: OPTIONAL, unused today. Google iOS client ID. Needed when blocker B1 is paid.
